scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @fluyo/shared && npm run build --workspace @fluyo/api && npm run build --workspace @fluyo/web
scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @fluyo/shared && dotenv -e .env -- concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev --workspace @fluyo/api" "npm run dev --workspace @fluyo/web"
scripts.lint: eslint scripts --max-warnings=0 && npm run lint --workspace @fluyo/shared && npm run lint --workspace @fluyo/api && npm run lint --workspace @fluyo/web
scripts.test: npm run test:audit-policy && npm run test --workspace @fluyo/shared && npm run test --workspace @fluyo/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @fluyo/shared && npm run typecheck --workspace @fluyo/api && npm run typecheck --workspace @fluyo/web
